scope: Read-only coexistence, overlap, replacement and identity review for C1, C2, C3, RQTB, TSBG, S2 and S1. No execution or mutation of prior evidence.

direct_answers.tsbg: TSBG is an exact C2 memory/row-broadcast specialization. It may replace ordinary per-token row fetch/descriptor scan after passing its same-capacity row-buffer baseline, but it does not replace typed K8 issue, bank service, shared Acc24 or completion.
direct_answers.s2_with_c1: S2 is architecturally serializable before C1 fetch. Its performance denominator must enable C1 exact product capture and count only incremental residual fetch/product/update. O16 drop saves weight bytes only if the physical store can suppress an O16 bank/burst instead of reading the full O96/1152-bit row.
direct_answers.s1_vs_s2: S1 and S2 are mutually exclusive main lossy modes by default because they share the fetch-before-compute stage and destination debt owner. A hierarchy is allowed only with one shared debt ledger, a combined bound, one charged metadata path and incremental same-resource evidence.
direct_answers.rqtb_vs_c3: RQTB and C3 are mathematically and state-semantically orthogonal, but not proven physically zero-cost orthogonal. Shared SRAM ports, phase control and adjacent attention-local ATLIF remain composition costs.

mechanism_roles.replacement: selected_main_lossy_mode_if_admitted; replaces G11-like policy and demotes S1

mandatory_s2_c1_gates: O16 or equivalent candidate block must map to an independently suppressible physical bank or burst
baseline enables C1 product capture, dead-write and zero-source mechanisms
skip preserves parent liveness, destination terminal, close and final commit semantics
metadata/debt port conflicts with directory/parent/weight ports are charged
combined cycles come from one transition replay and never from multiplying local ratios

identity.tsbg_current_boundary: M1558 is exact only for captured diagnostic codeword and contributor. hardware_quantization_authority=false and model_bit_exact=false.
identity.lossy_boundary: S1/S2 epsilon>0 creates a distinct runtime policy identity and requires paired per-sequence AEE; epsilon=0 must return the exact transaction stream.

admitted_metric_context.C1: CPU same-ledger four-bottleneck-Conv speedup about 1.759x; not RTL or system speedup.
admitted_metric_context.C2: Five directed workloads: K8 1913 versus equal-bandwidth K1x8 1945 cycles = 1.016728x; throughput/mm2 4.541078x; logic area reduction 77.6104 percent. Not system speedup or power.
admitted_metric_context.C3: 28-nm 3-ns logic-only hold-closed component evidence exists; no throughput, speedup, power or macro-inclusive PPA.
admitted_metric_context.RQTB: Local attention core about 1.182914x while current full-envelope mapping is about 1.000911x. Supporting only.
admitted_metric_context.new_candidates: No TSBG/S1/S2 cycle, traffic, energy, AEE, RTL or PPA result is admitted by this review.
